answer: Paramedic registration with ambulance shift history is the check: shifts served with one service across years. A farm faking 549 aliases needs 549 separate shift histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The anchor test is the price tag: 549 fakes mean 549 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The karst signal is visible to every grader, and the willow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
